victorious--adj.def: Having won a game or a war.
victorious--adj.ex: The victorious team toured the town.

duration--noun.def: The length of time something continues.
duration--noun.ex: The duration of the course is ten weeks.

formality--noun.def: Something done only because the rules require it.
formality--noun.ex: The interview was a mere formality.

smug--adj.def: Too pleased with yourself in a way that annoys others.

dominant--adj.ex: One firm is dominant in this market.

transit--noun.def: The movement of people or goods through a place.
transit--noun.ex: The goods were damaged in transit.

beforehand--adv.def: Before a particular event or time.
beforehand--adv.ex: Let me know beforehand if you cannot come.

synthetic--adj.def: Made by chemical process rather than from nature.
synthetic--adj.ex: The rope is synthetic and very strong.

ethical--adj.def: Relating to what is morally right.

comply--verb.def: To obey a rule or a request.
comply--verb.ex: All shops must comply with the law.

superficial--adj.def: Not deep or thorough, affecting only the surface.

fraction--noun.def: A small part of something, or a number like one half.
fraction--noun.ex: It cost a fraction of the usual price.
fraction--noun.exTr: Normal fiyatın çok küçük bir kısmına mal oldu.

sap--noun.def: The liquid that carries food inside a plant.
sap--noun.ex: Sap runs from the cut bark.

provisions--noun.def: Supplies of food kept for a journey or a period.
provisions--noun.ex: They packed provisions for a week.

exhaust--verb.def: To use something up completely, or to tire someone out.

climax--noun.def: The most exciting or important point of an event.
climax--noun.ex: The chase is the climax of the film.

craving--noun.def: A very strong wish for something, often food.
craving--noun.ex: She had a craving for salt.
craving--noun.exTr: Tuza karşı şiddetli bir isteği vardı.

obscure--verb.def: To make something hard to see or to understand.

obscure--adj.def: Not well known, or difficult to understand.
obscure--adj.exTr: Az bilinen bir şairden alıntı yaptı.

sarcasm--noun.def: Remarks that mean the opposite of what they say, used to mock.
sarcasm--noun.ex: There was sarcasm in her reply.

suffice--verb.def: To be enough for a purpose.

credible--adj.def: Able to be believed or trusted.
credible--adj.ex: The witness gave a credible account.

tinker--verb.def: To make small changes to something to improve it.

tinker--noun.def: A travelling worker who mended pots in the past.
tinker--noun.ex: A tinker used to visit each spring.
tinker--noun.exTr: Her ilkbahar bir gezgin tamirci uğrardı.

tangled--adj.def: Twisted together in a messy way.

plunge--verb.def: To fall or move suddenly downwards.

pioneer--verb.def: To be the first to develop a method or an idea.

pioneer--noun.def: A person who is the first to do something.
pioneer--noun.ex: He was a pioneer of local radio.

stuffy--adj.def: Without fresh air, or too formal in manner.
stuffy--adj.ex: The room is stuffy; open a window.

munch--verb.def: To eat something noisily and steadily.

demise--noun.def: The end of something, or a person's death.
demise--noun.ex: The demise of the factory hurt the town.

canoe--noun.def: A light narrow boat moved with a paddle.
canoe--noun.ex: They crossed the lake by canoe.

imperative--adj.ex: It is imperative that we leave now.

cavity--noun.def: A hole or an empty space, especially in a tooth.

mythology--noun.def: The old stories of gods and heroes of a people.

render--verb.def: To cause something to be in a certain state, or to give service.

fatigue--noun.def: Extreme tiredness after effort or illness.

hedgehog--noun.def: A small animal covered in sharp spines.

forfeit--verb.def: To lose a right because of a rule or a mistake.

astray--adv.def: Away from the right path or the right behaviour.
astray--adv.ex: The letter must have gone astray.

farce--noun.def: A funny play with silly situations, or a ridiculous event.

scramble--noun.def: A hurried struggle to get or to reach something.
scramble--noun.ex: There was a scramble for tickets.

aquarium--noun.def: A glass tank for fish, or a building displaying sea life.

gruesome--adj.def: Extremely unpleasant, usually involving injury or death.

intellect--noun.def: The ability to think and understand at a high level.

posture--noun.def: The way you hold your body when standing or sitting.

flourish--noun.def: A confident showy movement or gesture.

flourish--verb.def: To grow well and be successful.
flourish--verb.ex: The business flourished after the road opened.

rumble--verb.def: To make a long deep rolling sound.

rumble--noun.ex: We heard the rumble of traffic.

mingle--verb.def: To mix with other people at a social event.

confinement--noun.def: The state of being kept in a closed space.
confinement--noun.ex: He spent a year in confinement.

elusive--adj.def: Hard to find, to catch or to describe.

exterior--noun.def: The outside of a building or an object.

turmoil--noun.def: A state of great confusion and trouble.

oblige--verb.def: To force someone by law or duty, or to do someone a favour.
oblige--verb.ex: The rule obliges drivers to stop.

ferocious--adj.ex: A ferocious storm hit the coast.

plaque--noun.def: A flat sign fixed to a wall, or a coating on teeth.

snail--noun.def: A small soft creature with a shell that moves very slowly.
snail--noun.ex: A snail crossed the wet path.

fiend--noun.def: A very cruel person, or an evil spirit.
fiend--noun.ex: The papers called him a fiend.

voluntary--adj.def: Done by choice and without payment.
voluntary--adj.ex: She does voluntary work at the clinic.

diversity--noun.def: The presence of many different kinds within a group.
diversity--noun.ex: The forest has great plant diversity.
diversity--noun.exTr: Ormanda büyük bir bitki çeşitliliği var.

orchard--noun.def: A piece of land where fruit trees grow.
orchard--noun.ex: The orchard produces apples and pears.
orchard--noun.exTr: Meyve bahçesi elma ve armut veriyor.

refresh--verb.def: To make someone feel less tired, or to update a screen.

collaboration--noun.def: The act of working together on a project.

reassure--verb.def: To say something that removes someone's worry.

crumble--verb.def: To break into small pieces, or to fail gradually.

demolition--noun.def: The act of pulling a building down.

staggering--adj.def: So large or surprising that it is hard to believe.

tedious--adj.def: Boring because it lasts too long.

maternal--adj.def: Relating to a mother, or from your mother's family.
maternal--adj.ex: His maternal grandfather was a fisherman.

harass--verb.def: To trouble someone repeatedly in an unpleasant way.
harass--verb.ex: Nobody should be harassed at work.

plausible--adj.def: Seeming reasonable and likely to be true.

restoration--noun.def: The work of returning something to its original state.
